donationPolicy.title: Donation and Refund Policy
donationPolicy.creditInfo: Through donations, players acquire the in-game currency Credits (mmo-portal), which is used to purchase items and services on the server.

refundRules.title: Refund Rules
refundRules.description: Players can request a refund of unused Credits back to real currency.
requirements: To request a refund, you must write to the email rzfun@atomicmail.io, you must write from the email with which the registration was performed
Refunds are processed only in USDT TRC20 cryptocurrency
Minimum refund amount (excluding network fees): 1 USDT = 70 Credits
Network transaction fees are covered by the player
Only unused Credits balance on the character is eligible for refund
Refund request processing may take up to 7 business days

User uses the server at their own risk

gameRules.title: Game Rules
items: Discussion of other servers in general chat is prohibited

finalNote: By using the game server, you agree to these terms. If you disagree with the terms, please stop using the service.
